outcome: skilled birth attendant (SBA) use during childbirth
postnatal care (PNC) utilisation 48 hours after delivery
cohort: The study included 430 postpartum women who delivered 1 year prior to the study and were attending for reproductive, maternal and child health (RCH) services in Mwanza City, Tanzania.
finding: Male involvement during ANC was significantly associated with four or more ANC visits but not with skilled birth attendant use or postnatal care utilisation.
